description: This file contains a Kotlin implementation of a JPEG size limiter. It includes data structures and algorithms to iteratively compress and scale images to meet a maximum byte size constraint, by adjusting quality and dimensions.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the result of JPEG size limiting, including the compressed image bytes, dimensions, and quality.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiter
classes.description: Object containing the 'compressToLimit' function, which reduces JPEG image size within specified constraints by adjusting quality and scale.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses and scales an image to ensure its byte size does not exceed 'maxBytes' by iteratively adjusting quality and dimensions.
